name: app-onboarding-question-screen-on-blush-pink-with-gradient-arc-on-tufted-sofa
title: Blush-pink conversational onboarding screen with a rainbow gradient arc on a tufted grey sofa
whatItIs: A phone lies on a buttoned taupe leather sofa in raking light, its blush-pink screen showing a step tracker, a thanks line, a larger question in rust-brown text, a rainbow gradient arc and two pills: a white Write and an orange Let's talk, with a Skip link.
whatItMeans: Warm and soft; a pink screen and rainbow arc feel gentle on tufted leather.
techniques: Lay the phone on a tufted surface in raking light.
Use a rainbow arc as the assistant's presence.
Set the question in a single warm brown.

vocabulary.definition: Two buttons for typing or speaking.
